label: The co-existence of Ehlers-Danlos syndrome and postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome: A systematic review of the literature.
summary: There is a growing body of literature evaluating both postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome (POTS) and Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (EDS). We conducted a systematic review to evaluate what is currently known about the co-existence of both conditions. A search of MEDLINE and EMBASE was performed in December 2025 and data were collected in tables and pooled to determine the prevalence of POTS in EDS and EDS in POTS.
